text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your guidance today as well. 
I'm going to go cool down now.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"I don't care about cleaning duty! I'm 
busy picking herbs right now!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Cleaning can wait until next time! Just 
leave me alone!"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what...! Such explosive acceleration in 
a split second...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
In an actual race, that should become a 
razor-sharp late spurt... Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"I can't afford to lose to Sweep-san 
either... I must hone the sharpness of 
this 'Holy Sword' even further."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono. Please, allow me to continue 
training just as I am!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
You have my gratitude. ...My sword's 
sharpness remains truly peerless.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"I'll train myself so I can run sharper 
than anyone else!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Overworking is not good. Just as a sword 
wears down if sharpened excessively, I 
told her that moderation is essential.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: I see... That might indeed be the case.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
The way of the sword is not mastered in a 
day. Let us rest our bodies for today.
